note_ko: 장소별 문장 재료. 합성기가 시간대·카메라 선택에 맞춰 골라 문장으로 엮는다. {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}=her 같은 인칭 자리표시자를 쓴다.
setting_en: a quiet sandy beach with fine pale sand and gentle shallow waves
water_en: small waves rolling in with soft white foam
the sea rippling in long gentle lines toward the horizon
ground_en: wet sand shining like a thin mirror each time a wave slides back
shells and small bits of driftwood scattered along the waterline
far_en: a wooden beach pavilion far down the shore
a low seawall fading into the haze in the distance
skin_en: a few droplets of sea water cling to {p} bare skin

해질녘.sky_en: the sun hanging low and orange above a clear horizon
해질녘.sun_en: the low sun sits in front of {o} and to the camera's left, its warm light falling directly on {p} face, shoulders and the satin of the bikini, with a soft golden rim along the edge of {p} hair
해질녘.glitter_en: the sunlight breaks into bright glittering points across the rippling water
해질녘.shadow_en: long soft shadows stretch across the sand toward the camera's right

오후.sky_en: a high pale-blue sky with a few thin clouds
오후.sun_en: the afternoon sun shines from high in front of {o} and to the camera's left, lighting {p} face, shoulders and the satin of the bikini with clear warm highlights
오후.glitter_en: the sunlight scatters into sparkling points across the turquoise water
오후.shadow_en: short soft shadows pool under {p} on the sand

파도 발목.pose_en: walks barefoot along the waterline in a relaxed stride
파도 발목.moment_en: a shallow wave slides around {p} ankles and {s} smiles a little wider

천천히 걷기.pose_en: walks barefoot along the waterline in a relaxed stride
천천히 걷기.moment_en: {s} glances back toward the camera as the foam fades around {p} feet

camera.전신: Full-length shot from eye level with a 35mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head down to {p} bare feet in the shallow foam, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the sea softly out of focus
camera.무릎 위: Medium-long shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to just above the knees, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the sea softly out of focus

style_en: natural travel-editorial photography with fine film grain and realistic skin texture
